name: OneLove ~ONE LOVE~
source:
A boy and two girls of the same age has sex at last, on a large number of chance events. This work is Part 1 of a 2 part series. Part 2 will features them when they are adults.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE022853.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩和两个同龄的女孩在大量的偶然事件中终于发生了性行为。本作品是由2部分组成的系列的第1部分。第2部分将介绍他们成年后的情况。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE022853.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
